aliases: Gibson County Industrial Park data center
status_detail: City of Humboldt, Humboldt Utilities, Humboldt Chamber, and local economic-development partners announced July 23, 2026 that a new data center was under construction on approximately two acres near the outskirts of Humboldt, just outside/adjacent to the Gibson County Industrial Park; the release says it will operate as a 15 MW cryptocurrency mining facility and had TVA engineering/feasibility review plus Humboldt Planning Commission review/approval before construction began. WBBJ reported July 27, 2026 that local leaders said it could be fully operational by August 2026.
notes: Project owner/developer was not identified in the official release. Included despite crypto-mining use because local officials call it a data center and it is a high-impact data-processing facility using 15 MW.
